description: List official documents filed by a French company at the INPI RNE registry: legal deeds (statutes, general-meeting minutes, mergers...) and filed annual accounts, with document IDs to download the PDFs. Partial diffusion (rule diffusion_partielle_nom_retenu_et_compte): for a unit not proven to be a legal person, denomination and every nom_document are null, each counted in ecartes.diffusion_partielle; the filings stay listed. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: list_french_company_documents

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: List French company documents (INPI)
